description: Northern Provincial Council - Amendment  to the Health Service Statute of Northern Province, No. 1 of 2015 and the Northern Province Health Services (Amendment) Statute, No. 10 of 2016
reasoning: This gazette content enacts a statutory amendment to the Northern Province Health Service Statute, which falls under legal/regulatory matters.
